image_description: A blue, rectangular street sign mounted on a textured, light purple/grey brick wall. The sign appears warped and melted, with the text 'RUE DE LA PAIX' (or similar French street name) distorted and illegible due to AI generation artifacts. The sign is not on a vertical post but seems fused into the wall surface.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The right edge of the sign curls and melts into the background wall, losing its rigid geometric structure entirely.
The text is completely illegible, with characters merging, warping, and forming nonsensical shapes. It fails to render readable words.
The sign lacks planar rigidity, appearing bent and warped in a way that defies physical material properties of metal or plastic.
Edge bleeding occurs where the sign meets the wall, with textures blending unnaturally rather than showing a sharp occlusion boundary.
